static_audit_command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(".")
base = "f6b3d14e609dbdc784983f4b435adfe47a362c7b"
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
snapshots = {
"v1-05c2d4-before-failure.py": "src/orze/engine/failure.py",
"v1-05c2d4-before-caller-authority-failure.py": "src/orze/engine/failure.py",
"v1-05c2d4-before-caller-authority-launcher.py": "src/orze/engine/launcher.py",
"v1-05c2d4-before-caller-authority-phases.py": "src/orze/engine/phases.py",
}
out = {"baseline_snapshots": [], "draft_snapshots": [], "new_tests": []}
for name, source in snapshots.items():
    raw = (root / "docs/evidence/snapshots" / name).read_bytes()
    assert raw == subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", base + ":" + source])
    assert raw.endswith(b"\n")
    ast.parse(raw)
    out["baseline_snapshots"].append({"path": "docs/evidence/snapshots/" + name, "source": source, "sha256": sha(raw), "bytes": len(raw)})
for name in ["v1-05c2d4-before-callback-timeout.py", "v1-05c2d4-before-default-route-capture-failure.py", "v1-05c2d4-before-policy-type-check-failure.py"]:
    path = root / "docs/evidence/snapshots" / name
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert raw.endswith(b"\n")
    ast.parse(raw)
    out["draft_snapshots"].append({"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(raw), "bytes": len(raw)})
new_tests = sorted(set(root.glob("tests/test_bounded_executor*.py")) | set(root.glob("tests/test_executor_fix*.py")))
for path in new_tests:
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    out["new_tests"].append({"path": str(path), "sha256": sha(raw), "assert_nodes": sum(isinstance(node, ast.Assert) for node in ast.walk(tree))})
out["assert_nodes_total"] = sum(row["assert_nodes"] for row in out["new_tests"])
changed = subprocess.check_output(["git", "diff", "--name-only", base, "--", "src", "tests", "pyproject.toml"], text=True).splitlines()
baseline_paths = set(subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", base, "--", "src", "tests", "pyproject.toml"], text=True).splitlines())
changed_existing = [path for path in changed if path in baseline_paths]
assert changed_existing == ["src/orze/engine/failure.py", "src/orze/engine/launcher.py"], changed_existing
out["tracked_changed"] = changed_existing
failure = ast.parse((root / "src/orze/engine/failure.py").read_bytes())
wrapper = next(node for node in failure.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == "_run_bounded_executor")
assert any(isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) and node.func.id == "run_bounded_executor" for node in ast.walk(wrapper))
assert not any(isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and node.attr in {"Popen", "communicate"} for node in ast.walk(wrapper))
launcher = ast.parse((root / "src/orze/engine/launcher.py").read_bytes())
tries = []
for node in ast.walk(launcher):
    if not isinstance(node, ast.Try):
        continue
    generic = next((handler for handler in node.handlers if isinstance(handler.type, ast.Name) and handler.type.id == "Exception"
        and any(isinstance(value, ast.Constant) and isinstance(value.value, str) and "[FIX-RETRY] %s relaunch failed" in value.value for value in ast.walk(handler))), None)
    if generic is not None:
        assert isinstance(node.handlers[0].type, ast.Name) and node.handlers[0].type.id == "TerminationUnconfirmed"
        assert len(node.handlers[0].body) == 1 and isinstance(node.handlers[0].body[0], ast.Raise)
        tries.append(node.lineno)
assert len(tries) == 6, tries
out["six_explicit_relaunch_hold_handlers"] = tries
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
PY

aggregate_checker_history.initial_command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, json, pathlib, shlex, subprocess
root = pathlib.Path(".")
canonical_path = root / "docs/evidence/2026-09-10-v1-05c2d4-bounded-executor-supervision.json"
report = json.loads(canonical_path.read_bytes())
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for entry in [report["root_validation"], report["inventory"], *report["references"]]:
    assert sha((root / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) == entry["sha256"], entry["path"]
inventory = json.loads((root / report["inventory"]["path"]).read_bytes())
assert inventory["pre_post_equal"] is True
assert inventory["counts"] == {"core": 622, "pro": 214, "total": 836}
for repo, directory, commit in [("core", root, report["code_commit"]),
        ("pro", root.parent / "orze-pro", report["baseline_pro"])]:
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(directory), "merge-base", "--is-ancestor", commit, "HEAD"], check=True)
    assert len(inventory["files"][repo]) == inventory["counts"][repo]
    for entry in inventory["files"][repo]:
        assert sha((directory / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) == entry["sha256"], entry["path"]
        raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(directory), "show", commit + ":" + entry["path"]])
        assert sha(raw) == entry["sha256"], (repo, entry["path"])
validation = json.loads((root / report["root_validation"]["path"]).read_bytes())
checked = subprocess.run(validation["static_audit_command"], shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
assert json.loads(checked.stdout) == validation["static_audit"]
support = subprocess.run(validation["supporting_audit_command"], shell=True, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
assert json.loads(support.stdout) == validation["supporting_audit"]
assert validation["verification"] == report["verification"]
assert report["case_classification"]["new_cases_total"] == 63
assert sum(report["case_classification"][key] for key in ("previous_commit_behavior_red", "previous_commit_controls", "new_requirements_and_mechanisms", "draft_behavior_red")) == 63
assert report["whole_v1_complete"] is False
commands = bodies = 0
def walk(value):
    global commands, bodies
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            if isinstance(child, str) and (key == "command" or key.endswith("_command")):
                commands += 1
                subprocess.run(["bash", "-n"], input=child, text=True, check=True, capture_output=True)
                if "<<'PY'" in child:
                    ast.parse(child.split("\n", 1)[1].rsplit("\nPY", 1)[0])
                    bodies += 1
                else:
                    words = shlex.split(child)
                    for i, word in enumerate(words):
                        if word == "-c" and i and words[i-1] in ("python", "python3"):
                            ast.parse(words[i+1])
                            bodies += 1
            walk(child)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for child in value:
            walk(child)
for document in [report, validation, inventory, *[json.loads((root / entry["path"]).read_bytes()) for entry in report["references"] if entry["path"].endswith(".json")]]:
    walk(document)
print(json.dumps({"status": "passed", "source_test_build_files": 836,
    "worktree_and_fixed_commit_hashes_exact": True, "snapshots": 7,
    "fixed_baseline_byte_equal": 4, "new_tests": 63, "assert_nodes": 181,
    "command_occurrences": commands, "python_bodies": bodies}, sort_keys=True))
PY
